result.clarifying_question: Is this question about (a) evaluating your own enterprise's coding agents using internal telemetry/data you will supply, or (b) an external research synthesis of how agentic coding-agent productivity is defined and measured in the industry — and if (b), what decision (e.g., adoption, investment, or measurement-program design) should the findings inform?
result.rationale: 'Are our coding agents productive?' is decision-changingly ambiguous: 'productive' has no defined metric, and as an analyst I can only use supplied/external sources — I cannot access internal telemetry. Whether the requester expects an internal evaluation (which I cannot perform without supplied data) versus an external synthesis of measurement approaches determines the entire mission scope, so guessing would risk inventing scope or authority.
